_source: HCM 7th Edition, Chapter 29, Section 5, Example Problem 1: Automobile-Oriented Urban Street, WESTBOUND direction (Exhibits 29-47 through 29-49). Same 1-mi five-segment facility as case1; westbound published segment values: Segment 1 (Exhibit 29-47) base FFS 40.9 mi/h, travel speed 23.4 mi/h, spatial stop rate 1.93 stops/mi, LOS C; Segment 5 (Exhibit 29-48) base FFS 37.9 mi/h, travel speed 17.4 mi/h, stop rate 2.75 stops/mi, LOS D. Segments 2-3 assume Segment 1's values and Segment 4 assumes Segment 5's (unpublished). Published facility results (Exhibit 29-49, westbound): base free-flow speed 40.1 mi/h (EXACT), travel speed 22.2 mi/h and spatial stop rate 1.93 stops/mi (approximate here: 21.5 and 2.14 — the unpublished westbound Segments 2-4 evidently perform better than the copied Segment 1/5 values), LOS C (exact), poorest-performing segment LOS D (exact).
